instruction: Candid action photograph, wide-angle side shot. In an indoor judo dojo with yellow tatami mats and a white paneled wall, the young woman in the blue judo gi (R1) on the left and the young man in the white judo gi (R2) on the right perform one-handed pushups. Facing each other, the young woman smiles as she reaches out her right hand to clasp the left hand of the young man, who looks back at her. The scene is brightly lit with even indoor light, highlighting the warm yellow mats and their athletic interaction.
elements: R1 reaches out her right hand to clasp R2's left hand
R2 is the partner whose left hand is clasped by R1's right hand
